# Doctrine Lexer

Build Status: [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/doctrine/lexer.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/doctrine/lexer)

Base library for a lexer that can be used in Top-Down, Recursive Descent Parsers.

This lexer is used in Doctrine Annotations and in Doctrine ORM (DQL).

https://example.invalid/projects/lexer.html
